title: 薄殼混凝土屋頂施工~Thin-shell concrete roof construction
focus: 以形狀而非厚度承載：薄膜作用、挫屈敏感度、模板成形與脫模控制~Carrying load by form rather than thickness: membrane action, buckling sensitivity, formwork shaping and decentering control
summary: 薄殼混凝土屋頂以數公分厚的雙曲面跨越數十公尺，靠的是形狀讓荷載以薄膜壓力傳遞；它的弱點是挫屈、邊緣彎矩、溫差裂縫與施工幾何誤差。本課從 Candela 的雙曲拋物面、Isler 的倒懸模型殼到蘇黎世聯邦理工學院在 NEST HiLo 的索網織物模板，說明殼形、配筋、模板、澆置脫模、幾何量測與長期維護的工程判斷。~Thin concrete shells span tens of metres with curved surfaces only a few centimetres thick, because their form lets loads travel as membrane compression; their weak points are buckling, edge bending, thermal cracking and construction geometry errors. From Candela's hyperbolic paraboloids and Isler's inverted hanging-model shells to ETH Zurich's cable-net fabric formwork at NEST HiLo, the course explains engineering judgement on shell form, reinforcement, formwork, casting and decentering, geometry survey and long-term maintenance.

units.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用~Shell form and membrane action
units.mechanism: 薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。理想形狀下殼面幾乎全受壓，混凝土的抗壓強度被充分利用；但只要支承條件、集中荷載或邊緣不符合薄膜假設，就會在邊緣與支點附近產生彎矩擾動區。球形殼在自重下，從頂部往下經向力一直受壓，環向力則在超過某個角度後轉為受拉，因此淺殼與深殼的配筋重點完全不同。~Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does. For an ideal form the shell is almost entirely in compression, making full use of concrete's compressive strength, but wherever supports, point loads or edges violate the membrane assumptions a zone of bending disturbance appears near edges and supports. In a spherical dome under self-weight the meridional force stays compressive from crown to base, whereas the hoop force turns tensile beyond a certain angle, so shallow and deep domes need very different reinforcement.
units.model: 球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。頂部經向力 N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m，壓應力 σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa，遠低於混凝土強度。環向力 N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] 在 φ ≈ 51.8° 由壓轉拉，殼面延伸超過此角度就需要環向抗拉配筋或環梁。數值為教學假設。~Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m. The crown meridional force is N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m, a compressive stress σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa, far below concrete strength. The hoop force N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] turns from compression to tension at φ ≈ 51.8°, so a shell extending beyond that angle needs hoop tension reinforcement or a ring beam. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。~Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent.
units.failure: 若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。~If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in.
units.misconception: 薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。~Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough.
units.practice: 設計審查時要求提交殼面薄膜力分布圖、彎矩擾動區範圍與支點推力路徑，並在圖面上標出環向受拉區與對應配筋；形狀變更（即使只是開孔或壓低矢高）都要重做整體分析。~At design review require plots of membrane forces, the extent of bending disturbance zones and the support thrust path, mark the hoop-tension zone and its reinforcement on the drawings, and redo the global analysis for any change of form, even a new opening or a lower rise.

units.anchor: 挫屈安全係數~Buckling safety factor
units.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性~Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity
units.mechanism: 薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。古典彈性理論預測的挫屈荷載對幾何缺陷非常敏感，實際殼體常只達到理論值的一小部分；混凝土的潛變會讓有效彈性模數隨時間下降，開裂也會降低勁度。因此設計者通常以折減係數把理論挫屈荷載降到實際可用值，再要求數倍的安全係數。Isler 一生建造近 1,400 座殼，研究者回推其殼平均厚度約 10 cm，正是在挫屈與材料用量之間取得平衡。~Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing; buckling governs: under compression, wherever local curvature drops or thickness is insufficient, the surface can suddenly snap inward. The classical elastic buckling load is very sensitive to geometric imperfections, and real shells often reach only a fraction of it; concrete creep lowers the effective modulus with time and cracking also reduces stiffness. Designers therefore apply knock-down factors to bring the theoretical buckling load to a usable value and then require a safety factor of several. Isler built nearly 1,400 shells, and researchers estimate his shells averaged about 10 cm thick, a balance between buckling and material use.
units.model: 球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。E = 30,000 MPa、t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002 時 p_cr ≈ 141 kPa；考慮缺陷 0.3 與潛變係數 2（有效 E 降為 1/3），折減後約 14.1 kPa。自重 1.92 kPa 加雪 1.0 kPa，安全係數 ≈ 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8；厚度減為 60 mm 時 p_cr 按 t² 降為約 79.5 kPa，安全係數只剩約 3.3。數值為教學假設。~The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)². With E = 30,000 MPa and t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002, p_cr ≈ 141 kPa; an imperfection factor of 0.3 and a creep coefficient of 2 (effective E reduced to one third) bring it to about 14.1 kPa. With self-weight 1.92 kPa plus 1.0 kPa snow the safety factor is about 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8; at 60 mm thickness p_cr falls with t² to about 79.5 kPa and the safety factor drops to about 3.3. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。必要時以縮尺模型做破壞試驗驗證形狀選擇。~Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude. Where needed, verify the form choice with scale-model tests to failure.
units.failure: 淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。~Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking.
units.misconception: 混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。~Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
units.practice: 挫屈檢核須明列折減係數、潛變假設與所用初始缺陷幅值，並與施工規範的幾何容許誤差連動：若施工單位無法達成該容許誤差，就必須回頭加厚殼板或加肋，而不是放寬驗收。~Buckling checks should state the knock-down factor, creep assumption and imperfection amplitude used, tied to the construction geometry tolerance; if the builder cannot achieve that tolerance, thicken or rib the shell rather than relax acceptance.

units.title: 直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力~Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear
units.mechanism: 雙曲拋物面同時是雙曲面與直紋面：曲面上每一點都有兩條直線完全落在曲面內。Candela 正是利用這個性質，讓木模板沿直線母線鋪設，把複雜曲面變成可由工人以直木條施作的模板，使薄殼在當時的墨西哥成為很經濟的建造方式，而且模板可重複使用多達約 10 次。1958 年的 Los Manantiales 餐廳以四個相交的雙曲拋物面組成八瓣拱頂，跨距超過 42 m，並把殼緣切成自由邊。在均布荷載下，雙曲拋物面殼面主要承受固定的面內剪力，對角方向分別為受壓與受拉，剪力再累積到邊緣構件。~A hyperbolic paraboloid is both doubly curved and ruled: through every point pass two straight lines lying entirely in the surface. Candela exploited this by laying timber formwork along the straight generators, turning a complex surface into formwork that carpenters could build from straight boards, which made shells one of the cheapest ways to build in Mexico at the time, with formwork reused up to about 10 times. His 1958 Los Manantiales restaurant combines four intersecting hypars into an eight-lobed vault spanning more than 42 m, with the shell edges cut as free edges. Under uniform load a hypar carries mainly a constant in-plane shear, compression along one diagonal and tension along the other, and the shear accumulates into the edge members.
units.model: 雙曲拋物面 z = c·x·y，平面 10 m×10 m、角落升高 3 m 時 c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹。均布荷載 q = 2.2 kPa 時面內剪力 N_xy = q/(2c) = 2.2/0.06 ≈ 36.7 kN/m，受拉對角方向需鋼筋 A_s = 36,700/435 ≈ 84 mm²/m，φ6@300 提供 94 mm²/m；邊緣構件在角落累積的軸力約 36.7×10 ≈ 367 kN。數值為教學假設。~For a hypar z = c·x·y on a 10 m×10 m plan with a 3 m corner rise, c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹. Under q = 2.2 kPa the in-plane shear is N_xy = q/(2c) = 2.2/0.06 ≈ 36.7 kN/m, and the tension diagonal needs A_s = 36,700/435 ≈ 84 mm²/m, met by φ6 at 300 mm giving 94 mm²/m; the edge member accumulates about 36.7×10 ≈ 367 kN at the corner. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以三維模型輸出主應力方向，確認受拉主方向與配筋方向一致；模板放樣時沿兩組母線各取數條直線，以全站儀量測其端點與中點高程，確認母線確實為直線、曲面扭率與設計一致。~Output principal-stress directions from a 3D model and confirm that the tension direction matches the reinforcement layout; when setting out the formwork, survey ends and midpoints of several generators in each family with a total station to confirm they are straight and the surface twist matches the design.
units.failure: 把殼緣做成自由邊卻未計算剪力流在邊緣的累積，邊緣會下垂並出現斜裂縫；配筋方向若與受拉主方向相差太多，裂縫寬度變大，鋼筋保護層薄的殼面很快出現鏽蝕。~Cutting free edges without accounting for the accumulated shear flow lets edges sag and develop diagonal cracks; if reinforcement is oriented far from the principal tension direction, cracks widen and the thinly covered bars soon corrode.
units.misconception: 雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。~A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
units.practice: 對直紋殼，模板圖應直接以母線編號與端點座標表示，現場以拉線檢查直線度；自由邊與邊緣構件的鋼筋錨定要在施工圖上放大詳示，並列為澆置前查驗項目。~For ruled shells, draw the formwork by numbered generators with end coordinates and check straightness with string lines on site; detail the anchorage of reinforcement at free edges and edge members at large scale and make it a pre-pour inspection item.

units.anchor: 殼板厚度與保護層~Shell thickness and cover
units.title: 薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度~Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness
units.mechanism: 薄殼的最小厚度通常不是由應力決定，而是由施工與耐久決定：鋼筋網層數、保護層、骨材粒徑與能否在斜面上振實。雙層配筋可以抵抗邊緣彎矩，但會讓厚度明顯增加；單層置中鋼筋網較薄，卻較難控制保護層。現代研究以纖維或織物補強取代部分鋼筋，HiLo 原型的殼厚平均約 5 cm，由邊緣約 3 cm 漸變到支點約 12 cm，支點附近加厚以承受集中反力與彎矩。混凝土配比需兼顧在斜面不流淌、可噴附或可振實，以及低收縮。~A shell's minimum thickness is usually set by construction and durability rather than stress: the number of reinforcement layers, cover, aggregate size and whether concrete can be compacted on a slope. Two layers resist edge bending but noticeably increase thickness; a single central mesh is thinner but makes cover harder to control. Current research replaces some bars with fibres or textile reinforcement, and the HiLo prototype averaged about 5 cm, grading from about 3 cm at the edges to about 12 cm at the supports, where concentrated reactions and moments demand more depth. The mix must stay on slopes without slumping, be sprayable or compactable, and shrink little.
units.model: 雙層雙向 φ8 鋼筋網、保護層 25 mm：t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm，取 90 mm；單層置中雙向 φ8：t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm，取 70 mm。厚度減少 20 mm 使自重減少 0.02×24 = 0.48 kPa，約為 90 mm 殼自重 2.16 kPa 的 22%。數值為教學假設。~With two layers of two-way φ8 mesh and 25 mm cover, t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm, so 90 mm is used; with one central two-way φ8 mesh, t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm, so 70 mm. Saving 20 mm cuts self-weight by 0.02×24 = 0.48 kPa, about 22% of the 2.16 kPa of a 90 mm shell. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以試拌與斜面試體確認配比在設計最大坡度下不流淌且可振實；澆置前以保護層墊塊間距與鋼筋網高程量測確認層數與保護層，澆置後以保護層測定儀抽查，必要時以鑽心確認實際厚度。~Confirm with trial batches and sloped test panels that the mix stays put and compacts at the steepest design slope; before casting check layer count and cover from spacer spacing and mesh-level survey, and after casting spot-check cover with a covermeter and, where needed, actual thickness with cores.
units.failure: 在斜面上混凝土下滑，造成上方變薄、下方堆積，薄處保護層不足且挫屈安全係數下降；鋼筋網被踩踏下沉後，原本置中的鋼筋貼近下表面，上表面收縮裂縫無筋控制。~Concrete sliding down a slope leaves the upper part thin and piles up below, so the thin zone has too little cover and a lower buckling margin; mesh trodden down during casting drops toward the soffit, leaving shrinkage cracks on the top surface unreinforced.
units.misconception: 薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。~Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later.
units.practice: 施工規範應同時規定殼厚、保護層與鋼筋網高程的容許誤差，並要求以走道板或懸吊踏板避免踩踏鋼筋網；斜面配比須先以足尺樣板試做，並列為開工前停檢點。~The specification should set tolerances for thickness, cover and mesh level together, require walk boards or suspended footplates so the mesh is not trodden down, and trial the slope mix on a full-size sample panel as a hold point before work starts.

units.anchor: 模板與支撐系統~Formwork and falsework
units.title: 模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模~Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric
units.mechanism: 薄殼的成本常由模板決定。Candela 以直木條沿直紋鋪設，Isler 則以倒懸布料模型找形，並在部分殼體以保溫纖維板作為留置模板。近年的替代方案是柔性模板：NEST HiLo 原型以鋼索網張拉在可重複使用的支架上，網上鋪聚合物織物作為模板，索網約 500 kg、織物約 300 kg，承載約 20 t 濕混凝土；混凝土以噴附方式施作，下方空間在澆置期間仍保持暢通。柔性模板的形狀會隨濕混凝土重量改變，所以設計必須預先計算索網受載後的形狀，反推無載時應有的幾何。~Formwork often drives shell cost. Candela laid straight boards along rulings, Isler found forms with inverted hanging-cloth models and left insulating fibreboard in place as formwork on some shells. A recent alternative is flexible formwork: the NEST HiLo prototype stretched a steel cable net on a reusable scaffold and laid a polymer textile on it as the mould; the net weighed about 500 kg and the textile about 300 kg while carrying about 20 t of wet concrete, which was sprayed on, and the space below stayed open during casting. A flexible mould changes shape under wet-concrete weight, so designers must compute the loaded net shape and back-calculate the unloaded geometry it needs.
units.model: 以單位寬度索帶近似柔性模板：濕混凝土 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²，跨距 L = 10 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m 時水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m；垂度增為 1.5 m 時 H ≈ 10.4 kN/m。可見曲率越大，邊界支架承受的張力越小。數值為教學假設。~Approximate the flexible mould as a unit-width cable strip: wet concrete 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²; with span L = 10 m and sag f = 1.0 m the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m, and with 1.5 m sag H ≈ 10.4 kN/m. Greater curvature means less tension on the boundary frame. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 柔性模板在澆置前後以三維掃描或全站儀量測控制點，與預測的受載形狀比較；索力以荷重計或張力計抽測。剛性木模則以支撐系統計算書核對澆置荷重、衝擊與施工人員荷重，並在澆置中觀察支撐沉陷。~Survey control points on a flexible mould with 3D scanning or a total station before and after casting and compare with the predicted loaded shape; sample cable forces with load cells or tension meters. For rigid timber forms, check falsework calculations for casting load, impact and construction live load, and watch for support settlement during casting.
units.failure: 柔性模板若以無載形狀直接當作完成形狀，澆置後殼面下垂、局部曲率變平，降低挫屈安全係數；剛性模板支撐若沉陷不均，殼體在硬化前被扭曲，脫模後出現無法修正的幾何誤差。~Taking the unloaded shape of a flexible mould as the finished shape lets the shell sag and flatten locally during casting, cutting the buckling margin; uneven settlement of rigid falsework twists the shell before it hardens, leaving geometry errors that cannot be corrected after striking.
units.misconception: 柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。~A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation.
units.practice: 模板與支撐須有獨立計算書並由臨時工程設計者簽認；柔性模板要規定預張力、控制點與允許偏差，澆置中設專人監看控制點變位，超過警戒值即暫停並調整。~Formwork and falsework need their own calculations signed by the temporary-works designer; flexible moulds need specified pretension, control points and tolerances, with a person assigned to watch control-point movement during casting and to pause and adjust when an alert value is exceeded.

units.anchor: 澆置順序與脫模卸載~Casting sequence and decentering
units.title: 澆置、養護與脫模卸載~Casting, curing and decentering
units.mechanism: 薄殼澆置要對稱推進，避免單側荷載讓模板或未硬化殼面不對稱變形；多數殼體從支點附近往頂部、或由低處往高處澆置，以利振實並控制斜面上的流動。脫模卸載（decentering）是殼體第一次以自身形狀承載的時刻，必須在混凝土達到規定強度後，以對稱、分級的方式逐步降低支撐，讓殼體平順地接手荷載。卸載過快或不對稱，會在早齡混凝土上造成局部彎矩與裂縫。薄殼表面積大、厚度小，水分蒸發快，早期養護不足會造成塑性收縮裂縫。~Shell casting must advance symmetrically so that one-sided loading does not distort the formwork or the unhardened shell; most shells are cast from near the supports toward the crown, or from low to high, to aid compaction and control flow on slopes. Decentering is the moment the shell first carries load by its own form: once concrete reaches the specified strength, supports are lowered symmetrically and in stages so the shell takes up load smoothly. Decentering too fast or unevenly induces local bending and cracks in young concrete. Shells have a large surface and small thickness, so water evaporates quickly and inadequate early curing causes plastic shrinkage cracks.
units.model: 早齡強度可用 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t)（t 以天計）估算。f₂₈ = 40 MPa 時，1 天約 8.2 MPa、2 天約 14.0 MPa、3 天約 18.3 MPa；若規定脫模強度 15 MPa，至少需約 3 天，低溫時還要延長。數值為教學假設，實際應以現場養護試體或成熟度法確認。~Early strength can be estimated by f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t) with t in days. For f₂₈ = 40 MPa it gives about 8.2 MPa at 1 day, 14.0 MPa at 2 days and 18.3 MPa at 3 days; with a specified striking strength of 15 MPa at least about 3 days are needed, longer in cold weather. Values are teaching assumptions; confirm on site with field-cured cylinders or the maturity method.
units.verify: 以現場同條件養護試體或埋設溫度感測器以成熟度法確認脫模強度；卸載時在頂部與邊緣設沉陷量測點，每一級卸載後記錄變位並與預測值比較，偏差超過警戒值即停止並由設計者評估。~Confirm striking strength with field-cured specimens or embedded temperature sensors and the maturity method; during decentering place settlement points at the crown and edges, record deflection after each stage, compare with prediction, and stop for designer assessment if the alert value is exceeded.
units.failure: 為趕工在強度不足時一次拆除支撐，殼體在頂部或自由邊產生過大下垂與裂縫，甚至局部凹陷；單側先拆使殼體承受不對稱荷載，支點推力方向改變，邊緣構件開裂。~Removing all supports at once before strength is adequate lets the crown or free edges sag and crack, possibly with local dents; removing one side first loads the shell asymmetrically, changes the direction of support thrust and cracks the edge members.
units.misconception: 薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。~Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab.
units.practice: 脫模卸載程序應由殼體設計者撰寫，列出卸載順序、每級降幅、量測點與停止條件，並在現場設停檢點，由設計者代表確認強度與變位後才進入下一級。~The shell designer should write the decentering procedure with sequence, lowering per stage, measurement points and stop conditions, with a site hold point at each stage where the designer's representative confirms strength and deflection before continuing.

units.anchor: 幾何掃描與曲率檢核~Geometry scan and curvature check
units.title: 成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減~Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction
units.mechanism: 薄殼對幾何誤差的敏感度遠高於一般構件，因為挫屈荷載取決於局部曲率半徑。殼面某處若被做得比設計平坦，該處的局部曲率半徑變大，挫屈能力就以曲率半徑平方的反比下降。因此驗收不能只看整體高程誤差，還要看在數公尺弦長範圍內的局部矢高，也就是局部曲率是否被保住。現代工地可用雷射掃描取得完整點雲，把模板完成面與殼體完成面都與設計曲面比較。~Thin shells are far more sensitive to geometry errors than ordinary members because buckling capacity depends on the local radius of curvature. Where the surface is built flatter than designed, the local radius grows and buckling capacity falls with the inverse square of that radius. Acceptance therefore cannot rely only on overall level errors; it must check local sagitta over chords of a few metres to confirm that local curvature is preserved. Modern sites can capture full point clouds by laser scanning and compare both the formwork surface and the finished shell with the design surface.
units.model: 弦長 l = 4 m、設計曲率半徑 R = 40 m 時矢高 s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m。若量到的矢高只有 0.03 m，局部曲率半徑 R′ = l²/(8s′) = 16/0.24 ≈ 66.7 m，挫屈能力約按 (R/R′)² = (40/66.7)² ≈ 0.36 下降，也就是只剩約 36%。數值為教學假設。~For a chord l = 4 m and design radius R = 40 m the sagitta is s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m. If only 0.03 m is measured, the local radius is R′ = l²/(8s′) = 16/0.24 ≈ 66.7 m, and buckling capacity falls roughly by (R/R′)² = (40/66.7)² ≈ 0.36, leaving only about 36%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在模板完成後與殼體脫模後各做一次雷射掃描，以設計曲面為基準計算偏差色圖，並以移動弦長檢查局部矢高；局部矢高偏差超過規定值的區域須由設計者以實測幾何重算挫屈。~Laser-scan the formwork when complete and the shell after decentering, compute deviation maps against the design surface and check local sagitta with a moving chord; where local sagitta deviates beyond the specified value, the designer must recompute buckling with the measured geometry.
units.failure: 只驗收控制點高程而忽略控制點之間的平坦區，殼體在驗收時看似合格，數年後在積雪或潛變下於平坦區出現凹陷；若模板誤差已知卻未在澆置前修正，事後只能以加肋或加厚補強，代價很高。~Accepting only control-point levels while ignoring flat zones between them can pass a shell that later dents in a flat zone under snow or creep; if known formwork errors are not corrected before casting, the only remedy afterwards is costly ribbing or thickening.
units.misconception: 薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。~A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter.
units.practice: 施工規範要同時規定整體偏差與局部矢高（或局部曲率）容許值，並把模板完成面掃描列為澆置前停檢點；掃描點雲與偏差報告要納入竣工資料，作為日後變形監測的基準。~Specify tolerances on both overall deviation and local sagitta or curvature, make a scan of the completed formwork a pre-pour hold point, and include point clouds and deviation reports in the as-built records as the baseline for later deformation monitoring.

units.anchor: 載重試驗與長期變位~Load test and long-term deflection
units.title: 模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位~Model tests, load tests and creep deflection
units.mechanism: 薄殼的設計史與實驗密不可分：Isler 以布料倒懸、凍結或灌漿硬化的模型找形並測試，再按比例放大；他的方法從 1957 年開始實驗，1968 年在實際工程中實現。完工後的驗證則包括載重試驗與長期變位監測。載重試驗以沙包或水袋分區加載，量測頂部與邊緣變位並觀察卸載後的回復；長期監測則追蹤潛變造成的緩慢下垂，因為潛變既增加變位，也降低挫屈安全係數。~Shell design history is inseparable from experiment: Isler found and tested forms with hanging cloth models that he froze or stiffened with cement, then scaled them up; he began experimenting in 1957 and realised the method in built projects in 1968. After completion, verification includes load testing and long-term deflection monitoring. Load tests apply sandbags or water bags zone by zone, measure crown and edge deflections and observe recovery after unloading; long-term monitoring follows the slow sag caused by creep, which both increases deflection and lowers the buckling margin.
units.model: 長期變位 δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ)。彈性變位 8 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時 δ_∞ = 8×3 = 24 mm，40 m 跨約為 L/1,670。載重試驗量到最大變位 6.0 mm、卸載 24 小時後殘餘 1.0 mm，殘餘比 1.0/6.0 ≈ 17%，小於 25% 的回復準則。數值為教學假設。~Long-term deflection δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ). With an elastic deflection of 8 mm and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, δ_∞ = 8×3 = 24 mm, about L/1,670 over a 40 m span. A load test measuring a maximum of 6.0 mm and a residual of 1.0 mm after 24 hours unloaded gives a residual ratio of 1.0/6.0 ≈ 17%, below a 25% recovery criterion. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 載重試驗前寫好計畫：加載分區與分級、量測點位置、基準量測、最大荷載持載時間與回復準則（可參考 ACI 318 第 27 章的載重試驗概念），並在每級加載後檢查裂縫；長期監測以固定測點每年量測頂部高程，與潛變預測曲線比較。~Plan the load test beforehand: loading zones and increments, gauge positions, baseline readings, holding time at peak load and recovery criteria (the load-test concepts of ACI 318 Chapter 27 are a useful reference), with a crack check after each increment; for long-term monitoring survey crown level at fixed points each year and compare with the predicted creep curve.
units.failure: 載重試驗只加在單一區塊而未涵蓋不對稱荷載，無法反映殼體最危險的半跨加載狀態；長期監測缺席時，殼頂逐年下垂到形成積水窪，積水荷載再加速變形，形成惡性循環。~Testing only one zone without asymmetric loading misses the critical half-span load case; without long-term monitoring the crown can sag year by year until it ponds water, and the ponding load accelerates deformation in a vicious circle.
units.misconception: 薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。~Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging.
units.practice: 載重試驗屬於結構安全試驗，須由結構設計者與第三方檢驗機構共同核准試驗計畫，並設中止條件；長期變位量測點要以不鏽鋼標記永久保存，量測紀錄納入建築維護計畫。~A load test is a structural safety test; the structural designer and a third-party inspection body must jointly approve the plan with stop criteria, and long-term deflection points should be permanent stainless-steel markers with readings kept in the building maintenance plan.

units.anchor: 溫差裂縫與防水層~Thermal cracking and waterproofing
units.title: 溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護~Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection
units.mechanism: 薄殼暴露在日照與夜間輻射冷卻之下，上下表面溫差大，殼板又薄，溫度梯度在受約束時產生顯著彎曲應力。Isler 的作法之一是在殼體內面留置纖維板模板作為保溫層，讓內側表面溫度接近外側，避免溫差造成屋頂開裂。裂縫一旦形成，雨水就沿裂縫進入保護層很薄的鋼筋區，薄殼的耐久問題往往從這裡開始。現代殼體常加防水膜或塗層，但塗層必須能跟著殼面變形且可維修。~Thin shells face sun by day and radiative cooling by night, so top and bottom surfaces differ greatly in temperature, and the thin plate develops significant bending stress where the gradient is restrained. One of Isler's measures was to leave fibreboard formwork in place on the inner face as insulation so the inner surface stays close to the outer temperature, avoiding gradient cracking. Once cracks form, rain penetrates to the thinly covered reinforcement, and durability problems in shells usually start there. Modern shells often add a waterproof membrane or coating, but it must follow shell movements and be repairable.
units.model: 受約束板的溫度梯度應力 σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]。E = 30,000 MPa、α = 10×10⁻⁶/°C、ν = 0.2、上下溫差 ΔT = 20°C 時 σ = 30,000×10⁻⁵×20/1.6 ≈ 3.75 MPa，超過約 3 MPa 的抗拉強度；以保溫把溫差降到 5°C 時 σ ≈ 0.94 MPa。數值為教學假設。~The stress from a restrained temperature gradient is σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]. With E = 30,000 MPa, α = 10×10⁻⁶ per °C, ν = 0.2 and ΔT = 20°C between faces, σ = 30,000×10⁻⁵×20/1.6 ≈ 3.75 MPa, above a tensile strength of about 3 MPa; insulation that cuts the difference to 5°C gives σ ≈ 0.94 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在殼體上下表面埋設或黏貼溫度感測器，量測夏季晴天日夜溫差，與設計假設比較；定期以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄裂縫位置與寬度，並以灑水或雨後檢查確認防水層是否有效。~Embed or attach temperature sensors on both faces to measure day-night differences on clear summer days and compare them with design assumptions; record crack location and width periodically with a crack gauge and crack maps, and check the waterproofing with water testing or after rain.
units.failure: 未考慮溫度梯度的殼體在完工後第一個夏季就出現網狀或經向裂縫，雨水滲入後鋼筋鏽蝕、混凝土剝落，薄殼保護層小，損壞速度比一般樓板快；剛性防水塗層跟不上殼體變形而龜裂，反而把水封在裂縫內。~A shell designed without the gradient cracks in a map or meridional pattern in its first summer, rain gets in, bars corrode and concrete spalls, and with small cover damage advances faster than in ordinary slabs; a rigid coating that cannot follow shell movement cracks and traps water inside the cracks.
units.misconception: 薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。~Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect.
units.practice: 設計說明中要列出溫度梯度荷載假設、保溫或遮陽策略與防水層類型，並在維護手冊規定裂縫檢查週期與修補材料；任何在殼面上新增設備或開孔都需設計者審查其對溫度與防水的影響。~State the temperature-gradient assumption, insulation or shading strategy and waterproofing type in the design notes, set crack-inspection intervals and repair materials in the maintenance manual, and have the designer review any new equipment or opening on the shell for its thermal and waterproofing effects.

units.anchor: 檢查與修復紀錄~Inspection and repair records
units.title: 長期耐久、修復與工程交接~Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover
units.mechanism: 許多 1950 至 1970 年代的薄殼至今仍在使用，研究者指出 Isler 的殼體已良好表現四到五十年，但薄殼的耐久裕度天生較小：保護層薄、表面積大，碳化與氯離子較快到達鋼筋。修復時不能隨意加厚或加設備，因為額外重量與剛度改變會影響薄膜狀態與挫屈安全係數。交接資料應包含設計曲面、實測點雲、配筋與保護層紀錄、脫模變位紀錄與長期監測基準，讓日後修復能在原形狀與原假設的基礎上進行。~Many shells from the 1950s to 1970s remain in use, and researchers note that Isler's shells have performed well for four to five decades, but shells inherently have smaller durability margins: thin cover and large surface area let carbonation and chlorides reach reinforcement sooner. Repairs cannot casually add thickness or equipment, because extra weight and changed stiffness alter the membrane state and buckling margin. Handover records should contain the design surface, measured point clouds, reinforcement and cover records, decentering deflections and long-term monitoring baselines so that later repairs build on the original form and assumptions.
units.model: 碳化深度 x = k√t。k = 3 mm/√年 時 50 年 x = 3×√50 ≈ 21.2 mm；保護層 20 mm 的殼面約在 (20/3)² ≈ 44 年碳化到達鋼筋。若保護層因施工誤差只剩 15 mm，時間縮為 (15/3)² = 25 年。數值為教學假設。~Carbonation depth x = k√t. With k = 3 mm per √year, x = 3×√50 ≈ 21.2 mm at 50 years, so a shell with 20 mm cover is carbonated to the bars at about (20/3)² ≈ 44 years; if construction error leaves only 15 mm, that drops to (15/3)² = 25 years. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期以酚酞試驗量測碳化深度、以保護層測定儀與半電池電位圖評估鋼筋腐蝕風險，結果與竣工保護層紀錄比對；修復設計須以實測幾何與材料重新計算薄膜力與挫屈，並由原設計者或同等資格者簽認。~Measure carbonation depth periodically with phenolphthalein, assess corrosion risk with a covermeter and half-cell potential mapping, and compare with the as-built cover records; repair designs must recompute membrane forces and buckling from measured geometry and materials and be signed by the original designer or an equally qualified engineer.
units.failure: 修復時在殼面加鋪厚重防水層或增設空調設備，自重增加卻未重新檢核挫屈，安全係數在不知情下降低；缺少竣工點雲與變位紀錄，管理單位無法判斷殼體是否仍在持續下垂。~Adding a heavy waterproofing build-up or HVAC equipment during repair raises self-weight without a buckling recheck, silently reducing the safety factor; without as-built point clouds and deflection records the owner cannot tell whether the shell is still sagging.
units.misconception: 薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。~Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer.
units.practice: 交接時移交設計曲面模型、實測點雲、保護層與碳化基準、監測點座標與允許變位，並在使用手冊中明訂殼面不得任意新增荷重或開孔；重大修復前須由結構設計者評估。~At handover deliver the design surface model, measured point clouds, cover and carbonation baselines, monitoring point coordinates and allowable deflections, and state in the user manual that no loads or openings may be added to the shell without approval; major repairs require prior assessment by a structural designer.

example: 設計練習：一座球形薄殼屋頂半徑 R = 40 m、厚度 t = 80 mm、E = 30,000 MPa，自重 q_g = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，雪荷載 1.0 kPa，合計 2.92 kPa。頂部經向力 N = qR/2 = 2.92×40/2 = 58.4 kN/m，壓應力 σ = 58.4/0.08 = 0.73 MPa。古典挫屈 p_cr = 1.18×30,000×(0.08/40)² MPa ≈ 141 kPa，缺陷折減 0.3 與潛變係數 2（有效 E 降為 1/3）後約 14.1 kPa，安全係數 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8。環向力在 φ ≈ 51.8° 由壓轉拉。若為省材料把厚度改為 60 mm：自重 1.44 kPa、合計 2.44 kPa，σ = 2.44×40/2/0.06 ≈ 0.81 MPa，應力反而上升；p_cr 按 t² 降為約 79.5 kPa，折減後約 7.95 kPa，安全係數只剩約 3.3。由此可見減薄殼體省下的是自重，失去的是挫屈裕度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際殼體的設計。~Design exercise: a spherical shell roof has radius R = 40 m, thickness t = 80 mm and E = 30,000 MPa; self-weight is q_g = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa and snow 1.0 kPa, total 2.92 kPa. The crown meridional force is N = qR/2 = 2.92×40/2 = 58.4 kN/m, a compressive stress σ = 58.4/0.08 = 0.73 MPa. Classical buckling gives p_cr = 1.18×30,000×(0.08/40)² MPa ≈ 141 kPa; after an imperfection factor of 0.3 and a creep coefficient of 2 (effective E reduced to one third) it is about 14.1 kPa, a safety factor of 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8. The hoop force turns tensile at φ ≈ 51.8°. Thinning to 60 mm to save material gives self-weight 1.44 kPa and total 2.44 kPa, so σ = 2.44×40/2/0.06 ≈ 0.81 MPa, actually higher; p_cr falls with t² to about 79.5 kPa, about 7.95 kPa after reduction, and the safety factor drops to about 3.3. Thinning saves self-weight but spends buckling margin. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real shell.
history: Félix Candela 1949 年在墨西哥成立營造公司，1950 至 1976 年間設計約 1,500 個案，其中過半建成；1951 年宇宙射線館的殼面最厚處只有約 5/8 英寸，1958 年的 Los Manantiales 以四個雙曲拋物面組成跨距逾 42 m 的八瓣拱頂。瑞士工程師 Heinz Isler 1955 年在工地看見濕麻布自然懸垂而受啟發，發展倒懸模型找形，建造近 1,400 座殼。2017 年蘇黎世聯邦理工學院與 Empa 以索網織物模板完成 HiLo 屋頂原型，2021 年 NEST HiLo 單元啟用，把柔性模板與噴附混凝土帶入薄殼施工。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Félix Candela founded his building firm in Mexico in 1949 and between 1950 and 1976 designed about 1,500 projects, more than half of them built; the 1951 Cosmic Ray Pavilion shell is only about 5/8 inch at its thickest, and the 1958 Los Manantiales combines four hyperbolic paraboloids into an eight-lobed vault spanning over 42 m. Swiss engineer Heinz Isler, inspired in 1955 by wet burlap hanging on a building site, developed form-finding with inverted hanging models and built nearly 1,400 shells. In 2017 ETH Zurich and Empa completed a HiLo roof prototype on cable-net fabric formwork, and the NEST HiLo unit opened in 2021, bringing flexible formwork and sprayed concrete into shell construction. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
